ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement; $650.0 million revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: Our credit facility requires us to maintain a total net leverage ratio not exceeding 3.75:1.00. At September 30, 2026, we were in compliance with our financial covenants under the Credit Agreement.

ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement; $650.0 million revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement also contains certain customary financial covenants and negative covenants that, among other things, include a requirement to maintain a minimum Interest Coverage Ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) and a requirement to stay below a maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement).

parsed.notes: No actual ratio values are disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance at September 30, 2026. The 3.75:1.00 Total Net Leverage Ratio limit can step up to 4.25:1.00 for four quarters after a Material Acquisition. The minimum Interest Coverage Ratio threshold is not stated. Senior net leverage ratio references that only set interest margins or fees are excluded.
